title: Secret protection must scale with software
author: Erin Havens
description: Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it. The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Today, one in three pull requests on GitHub involves an AI agent . A year ago, that number was fewer than one in 10.
takeaways: Once notified, a large number of these partners immediately revoke the token: OpenAI API keys, Google Cloud account credentials, Slack webhooks, Hugging Face user tokens, SendGrid keys, etc.
If that pace holds, within the next two years, most of the code pushed to GitHub could be written by an agent.
Covers supported provider patterns, including GitHub’s own tokens.
